fixtures.description: Redacted placeholder vocabulary shared by all fixtures. No real paths, users, tokens, charges or repository content.
Common golden report input: one bounded flight with markers, a wait interval, two commits, a failed then successful CI attempt, a PR and one AI turn with source-reported usage. Charge is unavailable.

AI overlap policy: same request key from usage-csv and hooks-stop collapses (usage-csv preferred), duplicate stop emission for one turn collapses, a daily dashboard aggregate is an alternative ledger, and an estimate with no strong key stays unassigned.
Missing and inconsistent time: flight has no stop marker, a wait interval has no end, one command has no timestamp and one command ends before it starts.

Branch ambiguity: the same branch name is checked out in two worktrees of one repo, one worktree becomes detached, and an AI turn carries a branch but no worktree or head. Attribution must stay provisional or unassigned, never strong.
Synthetic secret canary: a captured command carries a synthetic token in argv and env. Exported/explained evidence must never contain the canary string.
Unavailable, unsupported and disabled sources: coverage states and gaps with zero events. Metrics depending on them must return null with a reason, not zero.
